regrade_correction.reason: Source-self-stability (dedicated_stability_run: N reruns of the SAME unmodified SOURCE_verify binary) establishes only that this buffer is deterministic WITHIN one binary. It does not establish that a different, legitimately-correct GENERATED VARIANT reproduces the same value bit-for-bit -- that is a distinct question (cross-implementation floating-point reassociation, e.g. a different reduction/accumulation order), which this evidence cannot speak to. buffer_classification_regrade.py re-graded every archived variant for all 16 classified kernels under bit-exact grading and found this label newly false-rejects real, non-defective, previously-PASS variants -- so bit-exact grading is not licensed for it. Reverted from comparison_mode=exact to unclassified so the live pipeline falls back to the type-derived (ULP-aware) tolerance, matching prior behavior for this label specifically. Original source-self-stability evidence is preserved below for record; it remains true and simply does not settle this question.
